metadata.description: Validation test for the GNSS error model (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T03): 3000 s disarmed at rest in open sky. Per-axis RMS position and velocity errors match DOP × UERE, the slow error is correlated over 1 s, the fix is on the centimetre grid and stays 3D. Exact DOP and UERE-scale scaling is checked in __tests__/reference-models/fpv-gnss.test.ts.
